reason: I use AI all day at work, but I don't let it near my money, and a cartoon pet making trades for me makes that worse, not better. I already put money in my broker app every payday and it takes two minutes, so I don't see what I'd be paying for.
objection: An AI moving real dollars on its own, through a broker partner nobody has named, for a price nobody has set. The Tamagotchi makes it feel like a game when it's my savings.
would_change_my_mind: A named, licensed broker holding the money with SIPC coverage, plus a mode where the agent only suggests and nothing moves until I tap. And a serious look with the pet turned off.
